verdict.rationale: Asana documents an App Directory where third-party apps integrate to create tasks and kick off workflows (asana-docs-10), plus a public API, webhooks, and app-components framework for building/plugging in integrations (asana-docs-2, asana-docs-3, asana-docs-9, asana-docs-16), supporting a marketplace-style ecosystem. Missing for 10: an authoritative count or listing of 'thousands' of apps in the directory, and independent/community corroboration of marketplace breadth or ease-of-connection experience.
